He set up a network of trading forts known as zaribas through the region, and from these forts controlled local trade. \n\nJohn Gantt, a former U.S. Army Captain and fur trader, was contracted by a US national to guide a wagon train with about 300-1000 emigrants to Fort Hall for 1 dollar per person in $YEAR$. The winter before, Marcus Whitman had made a brutal mid-winter trip from Oregon to St. Louis to appeal a decision by his Mission backers to abandon several of the US-held Oregon missions. He joined the wagon train at the Platte River for the return trip. When the pioneers were told at Fort Hall by agents from our Hudson's Bay Company that they should abandon their wagons there and use pack animals the rest of the way, Whitman disagreed and volunteered to lead the wagons to Oregon. He believed the wagon trains were large enough that they could build whatever road improvements they needed to make the trip with their wagons. The biggest obstacle they faced was in the Blue Mountains of Oregon where they had to cut and clear a trail through heavy timber. Finally, they arrived in Oregon and settled the land.

For a while, we have purged these revisionist elements, but these new ideas are subtle, and some secretly envy the success of the West. It is time to stop ignoring these ideas and have an earnest discussion about the path $COUNTRY$ is to take to achieve socialism. Broadly, there are three ideas about this: to continue as we have been, to adopt some free market reforms, or to adopt limited democratic elements. We have gathered our people, but be warned: "The democracy of capitalist society is democracy for the rich."
This is a time of change

There are certain elements among the people who are the sworn enemy of any Marxist state. They are worse than capitalist sympathizers, worse than ethnic nationalists: they are the revisionists, who seek to destroy everything we have so carefully built in for the sake of pushing their own interpretation of socialism. Naturally, this is forbidden in $COUNTRY$. At this crucial point, perhaps it is time to pay them a visit and remind them what being a $COUNTRY_ADJ$ citizen really means?
We cannot turn against our own people!

The figure stood, alone in front of a column of tanks. He had had enough: the nighttime raids, the disappearances, the control of thought and discourse. Undoubtedly necessary measures of state security. Recently, it is true, there had been some...extra measures taken against a new wave of agitators throughout $COUNTRY$. A swift response, more than they deserved. And yet, if this man feels strongly enough in his convictions to stop the tanks, and if so many have gathered in peaceful protest...\n\nThere is no time for idle thought. The police stand ready to put this man away forever. Just give the word.

A message we have received recently has completely divided our leadership along ideological lines: a Western corporation wishes to invest in our infrastructure. While we can, of course, direct the investment, it comes with terms one could almost describe as capitalist. Undoubtedly we must build socialism, but how much capitalism can we tolerate if it helps achieve achieve our final result?
We will permit some investment under our direction

We have received a bizarre request: a multinational fast-food chain has applied to open a branch in $CAPITAL$. Some regard this as the beginning of the end, as multinational corporations are the clearly a new bourgeois imperialism. There is no suitable counter-argument for a true Marxist. Really, it is a laughable proposal.\nA bureaucrat enters the chamber to report that the bread line in $CAPITAL$ has reached record lengths, and has had to lower rations. What's worse, without food, some people are getting strange ideas about our benevolent rule.\nOnce he leaves, the chamber goes quiet. Some officials grimace, others look toward the paintings of our founders on the wall. A moment passes - what were we discussing?

Recently, some people have begun to openly petition the government for a loosening of restrictions on luxury goods in $COUNTRY$. Whether people just want to eat in restaurants, try out electronics, or simply wear a white suit, they are stirring up trouble and questioning longstanding $COUNTRY_ADJ$ policy.
We must change course so we do not sink.

His family was closely tied to the Revolution, and we were planning the standard mourning events in his home town, but it seems he has put something unusual in his will. We almost missed it among the usual devotions to the party, but it is there: he has clearly requested a funeral in the traditions of his ancestral religion. While the people, and even low-level party members, do this frequently, a practice to which we have turned a blind eye, the funeral of a man such as this, who has monuments in his family's honor, will make waves among the people.
What's the harm? Anything for a hero of the Revolution.
Senile fool! Religion is the opiate of the masses. No funeral.

Now that we have formed the first sovereign Uralic country in hundreds of years, the Finnish people are fiercely debating how we're gonna treat the other non-Finnish Uralic people. My question to you, mr. president is this: Does Suur-Suomi represent Uralic unity or Finnish irredentism?
All Uralic people are our brothers!
The Finnish language is more important!

\n\nOkay, enough is enough! This was not a part of the deal. Norway and Sweden would share the same king and that's it! If we want to bump up our defenses, we do so without anyone intervening. Sweden taking away our autonomy is a direct violation of the Moss convention! Denmark has promised to help us if Sweden attacks us but we have to make the first move of refusing annexation.
Sweden is once again the hegemon of Scandinavia!

\n\nWe have now proven that even with all of Scandinavia against us, we are still the strongest. Even the War of Scandinavia wasn't a match for our might. We can now annex Norway, take Bornholm and all of Denmark's colonies. The world will now think twice before poking Sweden as we are now practically a great power ourselves! We have long dreamed about a direct port to the Atlantic ocean, now we have the longest coastline in Europe! Sweden is now the undisputed hegemon of Scandinavia!
Norway and Denmark won the War of Scandinavia!

\n\nNorway hasn't won a war against Sweden since 1099 and together with our brothers overseas in Denmark, we asserted our dominance over the so-called "Lion of the North". Now, let's take back what's rightfully ours and leave Sweden to rot in the mud, for Sweden is now weak and will most likely never see its prime ever again. Celebrations will be held all over Norway as we are now independent for the first time since 1380!
Denmark and Norway won the War of Scandinavia!

\n\nOur arch-rivals have been stomped by the mighty Denmark. We thought our prime was over after the loss of Norway in the Napoleonic wars, but it seems we were wrong. Denmark is as strong as it has always been. Together with our Norwegian brothers overseas, we will take back what was stolen from us and leave Sweden to rot in the mud, for Sweden is now weak and will most likely never see its prime ever again.

\n\nIt is no coincidence that the continental territories were left with after 1809 were the only Swedish-speaking lands in the world! If we want to prevent this from ever happening again, we need to aggressively impose Swedification of the revived Swedish Empire to make Norway once more the home of Swedes! On the other hand, it's immoral to destroy precious cultures and personal freedoms just to fulfill our dreams of Swedification. What is your say in the matter, my king?
Mecklenburg's loan on Wismar has defaulted!

\n\nFrom 7th of January of 1632 to 1803, almost 200 years, we were in control of the German-speaking city of Wismar but in 1803, we pledged both the town and lordship to Mecklenburg-Schwerin for 1,258,000 Riksdaler, reserving, however, the right of redemption after 100 years. In view of this contingent right of Sweden, Wismar was not represented at the diet of Mecklenburg until 1897. In 1903, we historically renounced our claims on the town.

\n\nIn 1803, Sweden loaned Wismar to Mecklenburg for some cash for a hundred years. Now, that loan has defaulted and Sweden is demanding Wismar back. Of course, we could just break the deal and keep it but that would be seen as an aggressive move as we are breaking a deal we've written with Sweden.
\n\nThey refused to return Wismar to us and has officially broken our agreement!

\n\nBéchar has become a destination for many fleeing Algerian rebels. Abd al-Qadir's army has fled there to launch guerrilla attacks across the Moroccan border with impunity. We must act and demand that the Moroccans hand over Béchar to us so that we may combat the Algerians.

\n\n$FROMCOUNTRY$ is demanding one our far-flung holdings in the Sahara, as the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ accuse us of harboring the Algerian resistance under Abd al-Qadir they're suppressing. Of course they're wrong, but we're powerless to convince them of this now. What do we do, my sultan?
\n\nThe Moroccans refuse to leave Béchar to us. They're forcing us to be aggressive!

\n\nEmir Abdelkader, leading the Algerians in their conflict with the French menace, needs all the assistance he can get to ensure victory. If we give his forces access to Morocco, they will have a slight advantage due to being able to retreat, travel through and recover in safe neutral territory. If we allow Algeria to fall, we may well be next. This will, however, worsen our relations with the French. On the other hand, this Algerian defense seems hopeless and it might be better if we supported the ivaders instead.

\n\nOn the 25th of May, 1810, the embers of revolution ignited, the chains that held us to the claw of the Iberian Lion were cut forevermore. A defiant roar that would culminate in the freedom of the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ state. This pivotal date stands as the foundational date of our nation, a day that would ultimately forge this glorious country. One hundred years have swept by since our people shouted: Libertad! Libertad! Libertad!

\n\nAt 8:36PM, a very powerful earthquake hit Mendoza in western Argentina, engulfing the city in disaster. As it was evening, people were either asleep in bed or indoors with benzine lamps to provide light. When the ground began to shake, the walls collapsed in on them, crushing thousands. Rubble falling into channels led to flooding in parts of the town, while others were set ablaze by the lamps. Five thousand perished in the tragedy. Two thousand homes, the colonial-era town hall and the Basilica of San Francisco were leveled, the remains burning to ash in the ensuing four-day fire. Thankfully, illnesses that would have been caused by leaving the dead to decay were avoided by transporting them to mass graves in the capital.

\n\nOnce again Uruguay has attempted to liberate themselves from our rule, resulting in a humiliating defeat. After the failed revolt in Montevideo, a great debate has arisen in $CAPITAL$: the fate of Uruguay. Although there are many ideas, our options come down to two: integrate them officially as a province of $COUNTRY$ or grant them independence under strict $COUNTRY_ADJ$ supervision. What shall be done with the rebellious Banda Oriental?

\n\nWe have succeeded in our fight for independence against the Argentines and, in $YEAR$, we have proclaimed a Uruguay free from foreign domination. It is now time to celebrate this crucial victory for the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ people.
Whatever it takes to set Japan on the right path.
The unrest grows worse each day.
The Shogunate shall reap what they sow.
The State of the Modern Shogunate
Let us rejoice, though, that Japan is stronger than ever before.
May the heavens grant him eternal rest.

\n\nDuring our righteous war against the savage federalists, $COUNTRY_ADJ$ forces have finally occupied Entre Rios and reached the Parana Delta. The province has been assigned to be governed by José Maria Paz, who will also rally troops and lead them to fight against Rosas' regime. However, the province of Entre Rios is largely federalist, and the local population will certainly be angered and might attempt to revolt.

\n\nWith Rosas unable to defeat the rebellions across the Confederation, we have finally seized Buenos Aires and assumed control of the government. Meeting with other unitarians in the country, they have drawn up a new constitution for Argentina. The Argentine Confederation was abolished and replaced by the unitarian-led Argentine Republic, while the former Governor and President, Juan Manuel de Rosas, was forced to flee the country and is now exiled in the United Kingdom.
They will get used to us, eventually.
Resistance to the New Japanese Regime Dies Down
We knew they would come to their senses.

\n\nThe Pacts of May, four protocols proposed in Santiago de Chile by Chile and Argentina on 28 May, 1902 in order to extend their relations and resolve its territorial disputes, are being negotiated. The pacts include selling off warships already in construction in Europe and working towards resolution of territorial disputes. If we were to sign these protocols, we could possibly lose part or all of our disputed claims on the Andes. However, refusing them could lead to possible war...

\n\nThe governments of $FROMCOUNTRY$ and Argentina find themselves in a dispute over their borders in the southern Andes mountain range. Argentina claims it lies along the highest peaks of the mountains, while Chile's claim states the border to follow the fluvial watershed. Both countries have signed an agreement to end this dispute on friendly terms, and we have been contacted to arbitrate this dispute. Who shall the land go to?

\n\nWilliam Lane, an Australian socialist, along with some 240 settlers, has come to our nation in the search to create his very own socialist utopia. The settlers were required to pay a minimum of 60 pounds to join the colony, and the small settlement has already begun to be formed. While Lane's strange ideals could prove dangerous to the safety of $COUNTRY$, it is unlikely anything will come of it.

\n\nA group of impoverished Saxon families from Germany, led by Bernhard Förster, have emigrated to $COUNTRY$ in the search of a place to found a utopian settlement in order to practice ideas regarding Aryan supremacy and the like. While these ideas could prove dangerous to our country, they are nothing more than a few colonists, and their development of the land could prove useful.

Ottoman sultans have never traveled to Eastern or Western countries except for campaigns, and only a few have traveled around the empire. Moreover, it is exceptional for Ottoman sultans to go on pilgrimage. Our Sultan, Abdülaziz, has never been in foreign lands. However, due to recent events, our Sultan has decided to break the “Darü’l- Harp” (Abode of War), and travel to Europe for diplomatic reasons. The journey has been thoroughly discussed in the palace, and finally a solution has been found. Special compartments built under sultan’s shoes will be filled with earth so that Sultan Abdülaziz would not step on foreign lands in the countries he visited.
The Rise of Palestinian Arab Nationalism

\n\nBefore the French Revolution a movement of radical-democratic republicans was active who wanted to dethrone King Leopold I, some by force. When the Revolution in France started, they mobilized and set up to do the same here. With the cooperation of the new republican government in Paris, thousands of Belgian guest workers were gathered and taken to Belgium on three trains. The intent was to arm them before the border and create a trail of revolution by associating themselves with local agitators and masses in the towns they passed. Thanks to infiltrated groups, we were informed of the preparations for it. The armament in France was partly prevented and one of the trains was defused. After a fierce firefight, the arrival of artillery was decisive and the republicans were dispersed at Risquons-Tout. Meanwhile, from Bruges to Virton, local riots and revolts were suppressed.

\n\nA train wreck occurred today in Whitemarsh Township, Pennsylvania, between Camp Hill station and Fort Washington station. Two trains, traveling on the same track in converging directions, collided, killing between 59 and 67, and injuring over 100. The incident is now referred to as The Camp Hill Disaster in Montgomery County, and The Picnic Train Tragedy in Philadelphia. It's now the deadliest railroad catastrophe to date.

After a deadly Revolution, we have been forced to write a new constitution. It has been written in a very liberal spirit. It establishes a balance of legislative and executive powers in that it conferres an important place on the Chamber of Deputies as a legislative body and as a body of control of the executive power. In addition, it proclaimes fundamental rights and freedoms, such as equality before the law, freedom of opinion and freedom of the press. With the demands of the Revolution fulfilled, our country can be in peace.

In a speech from the throne, the Governor of Luxembourg, Prince Henry, announced the amendment of the constitution, which he claimed was required to bring it into line with the rest of the German Confederation. Our constitution is too liberal, and it has to be reverted. The liberals in the Chamber are outraged, and demand that any changes respect the freedoms won in the Revolutions of 1848 and the independence of Luxembourg from the Netherlands, which was in a personal union with Luxembourg. We could ignore the liberals' opinion, which don't have much power in the chamber, and revert it anyway. That could provoke a new Revolution though.

"We herewith proclaim the independence of Korea and the liberty of the Korean people. This we proclaim to all the nations of the world in witness of human equality. This we proclaim to our descendants so that they may enjoy in perpetuity their inherent right to nationhood."

Since March 1st, approximately 2 million Koreans have participated in 1,500 individual protests against Japanese rule. The movement came as a long-coming powder keg of civil rest in Korea, a nation with an ancient history that has been totally subsumed by Japan. Despite their resolve to see their liberation through, the demonstrations were largely peaceful until the Japanese police lost the ability to control the crowds and sent in the military. The result has been massacres of Korean protesters by the thousands. Nevertheless, Koreans remain undeterred, ready to continue organizing.

\n\nIn recent times, a fair amount of Swiss immigrants have been arriving on $COUNTRY_ADJ$ lands to seek a better life. While most have settled in the large cities and areas of growing population density, some families seek to work the fields in Santa Fe instead, with some remarkable foundations regarding a colony named Helvecia. Provided we sell them a lease of land in the near-barren areas of the province, they could help develop the region.

\n\nJewish refugees from Kamianets-Podilski fleeing persecution are seeking to immigrate to $COUNTRY$. Initially thinking to settle an area of inner Buenos Aires province, the price of the land has risen and has made it impossible for them to purchase the properties in the area. Some aristocrats have offered an area of land around Santa Fe to the settlers, but this land has not met their expectations. They are currently living in deplorable conditions. Their plight has come to the attention of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs--we could help the colonists thrive with some economic aid, although it would be expensive.

\n\nFollowing the boom around the southern coast of Mar Chiquita, there have been talks of encouraging the small but growing fishing industry around the Miramar area. Although it could be beneficial, this also could end catastrophically and plunge the region into poverty if not handled correctly. Instead, a safer choice could be made: funding the Quebracho tree lumber industry on the lake's islands and coast.

\n\nThe plan to develop the Mesopotamia into the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ heartland was a success, but there is still more to be done. The regions adjacent to the Paraná river are not as developed as their immediate neighbors, creating a difficult contrast. There are proposals in $CAPITAL$ to extend the development plan to nearby regions. These could, however, be quite pricey.

With the Palestinian Arab insurgency defeated, the Arabs of Eretz Yisrael have been left deathly afraid of their future in their homeland of over a millennium. To secure the right for Jews to continue settling the land, and to prevent a fifth column from forever being present in Israel's borders, the Haganah's high command all expected an order to come to expel the Arabs or encourage them to leave. Such a command, however, never came to reality. The Arabs of the villages most affected by the conflict have not fled in panic, but have chosen determinedly to stay.

Zionist leaders have instead put their energy into building trust with Arab leaders. Haganah forces oversee the reconstruction of Jewish and Arab communities alike. Jewish towns' mayors negotiate with Arab mukhtars about resources and the state's future budget for both communities. There is still general distrust between Jews and Arabs due to their opposing aspirations for self-determination in the same land. However, steps toward reconciliation are rapidly being made.

Rural farmers, typically of poor background, are increasingly getting involved in Norwegian politics. This phenomenon is thanks to the rise of leaders representing the country's common people, such as Ole Gabriel Ueland and Søren Pedersen Jaabæk. Ueland started his political career as a farmer with no formal education, eventually coming to represent the district of Stavanger Amt in the Storting. He is respected for his advocacy for farmers' welfare. Jaabæk, in addition to now representing Lister og Magdals Amt in the Storting, has founded the Bondevennerne, a political advocacy group for peasants named after a similar organization in Denmark.

Norway is entering a new age of social progress. May the country and its people thrive!

\n\nOur control of India is in peril: native forces now occupy Bombay, Calcutta, Delhi, Jubulpore, and Patna--the Raj's foremost administrative centers. Our subcontinental adversary, therefore, has enough leverage to demand an end to our rule over India. It might be worth it to comply, lest we prolong this war and further embarrass ourselves globally.

\n\nEthnic Koreans have migrated to Manchuria in large numbers since the start of the 19th century, becoming a dominant ethnic group especially within the south of the region. Within recent years, however, Koreans have begun infiltrating into Manchuria in larger numbers than ever before to escape famine in our country's north, mainly Yanbian province and its surroundings. Yanbian province specifically is part a once disputed territory called Jiandao, claimed by us until 1712, when a treaty with the Qing demarcated our borders along the Tumen River. The number of Koreans in Jiandao has led to an interesting development: they claim that their demographics alone ought to make the land Korean soil. China intends to deport these migrants, and we must step in to protect them. Perhaps this means we ought to reassert a claim to Jiandao--or Gando in Korean.

Within recent years, however, Koreans have begun infiltrating into Manchuria in larger numbers than ever before to escape famine in the country's north, mainly Yanbian province and its surroundings. \n\nThe north of New Zealand's South Island was hit by a high magnitude earthquake today at 10:17 AM, creating widespread damage. The quake occurred within an epicenter around Nelson, Greymouth, and Westport, at a 12-kilometer focal depth. The surrounding region suffered large enough damages to lay ruin to roads, buildings, and bridges alike, within an estimated 26,000 square kilometers. 14 of the 17 resulting deaths resulted from landslides, while the other two souls perished in a coal mine collapse. Locals also report that the quake created a new water fall 8 kilometers southwest of Murchison, at the end of the Maruia River.

The earth continues to shake unpenitently and drag the people of New Zealand into the ground, burying them alive. At 10:47 AM, in the eastern North Island, a 7.8 magnitude earthquake struck that killed 256 and injured thousands. The Hawke's Bay region was utterly destroyed, thousands of its people suddenly thrust into homelessness.

The quake has been called the worst natural disaster in New Zealand's history. That label certainly does not feel premature--the destruction has even caught the King's attention, who telegraphed the Governor-General a message sharing his condolences.

A most unusual piece of "artwork" has appeared at New York City's inaugural exhibition of the Society of Independent Artists. The work, credited to Frenchman Marcel Duchamp, is a dismounted urinal placed on a wooden column, signed on the front with the pseudonymous signature "R. Mutt" and the year 1917. Duchamp presented the work as a "sculpture," whose purpose reflected how everyday objects may be "raised to the dignity of a work of art by the artist's act of choice."

The Society did not reject the work, as Duchamp paid the submission fee. However, they refused to display it at the exhibition. The sculpture's existence would come to light when photographer Alfred Stieglitz captured a photo of it at Manhattan's 291 Art Gallery. The work remains there as a curiosity--forcing the viewer to examine what even constitutes a piece of art.
Issue a Papal Bull condemning radicalism

The church does not rule us!
